skills.trigger: When evaluating a chest X-ray showing multiple bilateral pulmonary nodules to distinguish necrotizing variants of sarcoidosis from classic sarcoidosis or malignancy.
steps: Inspect the pulmonary nodules for margin definition and internal density, specifically looking for ill-defined borders or central lucencies that suggest cavitation or necrosis.

Differentiate from classic sarcoidosis (which typically presents with well-defined nodules and symmetric hilar adenopathy) and malignancy (often solitary or irregular masses) by identifying the combination of multiple varying-sized nodules with necrotic features.
